article.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Downloads Start November 10 Ahead of Launch
article.summary: Rockstar Games confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI will launch on November 19, with pre-downloads beginning on November 10 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
article.body:
Players must clear at least 212GB of storage space on their PlayStation 5 console to accommodate the upcoming release. This massive storage requirement reflects the scale of the title as users prepare to dive into the latest installment of the series.

Ensuring the game is downloaded before the official release date allows players to begin their experience immediately when it becomes available. By pre-ordering through the PlayStation Store or participating retailers, users secure their access and can take advantage of the pre-download window starting at local midnight on November 10. The game features a dual-protagonist story involving Jason and Lucia, with additional content included in the Ultimate Edition, such as exclusive vehicles, weapons, and apparel.

According to Rockstar Games, those new to the PlayStation platform should verify their account information in advance to prevent any delays during the launch window. Existing players are encouraged to check their sign-in credentials now. Preparation steps also include exploring storage expansion options if the 212GB requirement exceeds current console capacity. For those looking to upgrade their setup, accessories such as the DualSense Edge wireless controller and Pulse wireless audio products are available for use with the new game.

Rockstar Games maintains that the full launch for both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S remains set for November 19. Additional details regarding the game and its features are expected to be shared by the developer as the release date approaches.

article.headline: Two Lucky Winners Split Massive $12.2 Million Toto Jackpot In Singapore
article.summary: Two winning tickets shared the $12,198,558 Group 1 jackpot following the Toto cascade draw held on Nov 9.
article.body: The winning numbers drawn were 5, 27, 29, 38, 40 and 43, with 4 serving as the additional number. Each of the two triumphant ticket holders earned a share worth more than $6 million from the total prize pool, which reached $12,198,558. These winning entries were purchased through the Singapore Pools Account Betting Service, consisting of one QuickPick System 7 entry and one QuickPick Ordinary entry. Beyond the top prize, 12 shares were awarded in Group 2, with each share valued at $115,990. The significant payout followed a series of draws where the jackpot failed to find a winner, causing the funds to snowball from just over $1.1 million on Oct 29. By the time of the third draw on Nov 5, the total had already swelled to more than $5.5 million. The cascade draw process dictates that if no one claims the Group 1 prize after four consecutive draws, the accumulated money is split among winners in the subsequent prize group. This particular event marks the fifth time in 2026 that the jackpot has reached or exceeded $10 million, echoing a similar occurrence in July when two tickets shared a $12.8 million prize.

news.og_desc: يواجه أراس أزمة جديدة بعد القبض عليه للاشتباه في تورطه بمقتل سرحات، في مسلسل مازلت في السابعة عشر الحلقة 24 - Daha 17 وهو ما ينعكس سلباً على الحالة الصحية لليلى، بينما يحاول أراس إثبات براءته بعد هروبه من المستشفى، في الوقت الذي يسعى فيه هاكان إلى تحميله مسؤولية الجريمة. مسلسل مازلت في السابعة عشر الحلقة 24 بعد هروبه من المستشفى، يبدأ أراس رحلة البحث عن أدلة تثبت عدم تورطه في مقتل سرحات، لكن مهمته تزداد صعوبة مع تحركات هاكان الذي يعمل على توجيه أصابع الاتهام إليه، فيما تجد شيبنم نفسها أمام ضرورة اتخاذ خطوات لحماية عائلتها من تداعيات الأزمة.
